features.name: Aero7 Desktop Core
features.description: The desktop session, Control Panel, shell, and essential system integration.
features.compatibility: Required by every Aero7 session and cannot be removed.

features.name: Windows Snapping
features.description: Snap windows to the sides or top of a screen by dragging them to an edge.
features.compatibility: This switches Aero7 window snapping for your account. Sensitivity is adjustable in Control Panel > Window Behavior.

features.name: Programs Center Beta
features.description: Browse, install, remove, and update applications with Aero7's graphical software manager.
features.compatibility: Optional beta software. Aero7 installs the checksum-verified package kept on the installed system, so enabling it does not require an internet connection.

features.name: Parental Controls
features.description: Restrict applications and session usage for managed local accounts.
features.compatibility: Uses the official Arch Linux malcontent package.

features.name: Backup and Restore
features.description: Create scheduled backups and restore files while keeping backup data outside the system package database.
features.compatibility: Uses Déjà Dup from the official repositories. Backup archives and user configuration are retained when this feature is removed.

features.name: System Recovery
features.description: Create and manage filesystem snapshots on supported Btrfs installations.
features.compatibility: Uses Btrfs Assistant and Snapper from the official repositories. Existing snapshots are retained on removal.

features.name: Advanced Accessibility Services
features.description: Screen reading and speech synthesis for users who need spoken desktop feedback.
features.compatibility: Provides speech output and screen reading; it is not presented as speech recognition.

features.name: Speech Recognition
features.description: Control Aero7 and dictate text using speech.

availability.reason: No supported speech-recognition backend is available from the configured official repositories.

features.compatibility: Speech synthesis packages are deliberately not misrepresented as speech recognition.

features.name: Sync Center
features.description: Synchronize selected folders between trusted computers on the local network or internet.
features.compatibility: Synced folders and user configuration are retained when the package is removed.

features.name: Aero7 Defender
features.description: On-demand malware scanning and signature updates integrated with Action Center.
features.compatibility: Uses ClamAV from the official repositories; signature data is retained on removal.

features.name: Windows CardSpace
features.description: Windows CardSpace was a discontinued Microsoft identity technology and has no safe Aero7 equivalent.

availability.reason: CardSpace is discontinued and is not offered as a fake installable component.

features.compatibility: Use current browser or application identity methods instead.

features.name: Remote Desktop Connections
features.description: Connect to computers that provide Remote Desktop Protocol access.
features.compatibility: Client-only support; enabling it does not expose this computer to remote logins.

features.name: File and Printer Sharing
features.description: Share selected files and printers with compatible computers using SMB.
features.compatibility: Shares are never created automatically; existing share configuration is retained on removal.

features.name: Mobile Broadband and Modem Support
features.description: Manage supported cellular modems and mobile broadband connections.
features.compatibility: Shown as hardware not present when no supported modem can be detected.

features.name: Color Management
features.description: Manage device color profiles and color-corrected workflows.
features.compatibility: Installed ICC profiles are user data and are retained on removal.
